Exact ArrayBuffer transfer/restoration here is between real owned kernels using structuredClone, not an attestation of a browser live-AudioWorklet state handoff. The worker Playwright case separately renders/downloads a real captured phrase with concrete seed contracts.

The onset contract labels restoration as a declared kernel capability; it does not assert current live host transfer availability, hardware playback, waveform distribution quality or listening acceptance.
Matched-level A/B browser playback is an operational qualification, not a human listening judgement of ensemble relatedness.
